What We Do
data.subtitle: Explore our initiatives that foster practical skills and bridge the gap between theory and real-world applications.

data.text: Our workshops provide interactive learning experiences, covering topics essential to developing technical skills in data science and related fields.
Our competitions allow participants to demonstrate their knowledge and skills by tackling practical challenges in data science.
We host networking events that connect students with professionals and peers, creating opportunities for mentorship and career growth.
Join us for our next event! This is a great opportunity to connect with others and enhance your knowledge and skills.
Explore some of our recent initiatives and events that have enriched our members' learning experience.

The Visionary Lab bridges the gap between academic learning and real-world impact, connecting University of Calgary students with local organizations to solve real-world challenges through data-driven innovation.
Gain access to creative, no-cost solutions for your data challenges while empowering the next generation of talent.
Transform your classroom knowledge into practical experience that builds your skills, grows your network, and strengthens your resume.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to our incredible sponsors! Your unwavering support empowers us to create innovative solutions, provide hands-on learning opportunities, and make a meaningful impact in our community. Together, we are shaping the future of data science and technology.

We are grateful to collaborate with representatives from various leading organizations through joint projects and guest speaking engagements. These partnerships enrich our initiatives, foster learning, and help us create meaningful impact in the field of data science and technology.

Partner with us and connect with the next generation of professionals. Sponsoring our organization provides brand visibility, access to top talent, and engagement opportunities with students and academics.
